summary.lv: Quintessence (aviosatīras pārdošanas un pārvaldības programmatūras tirgus līderis) meklē tehnisko konsultantu, kurš būs pirmais kontaktpunkts klientu atbalstam un tehnisku pakalpojumu sniegšanai.
summary.en: Quintessence (market leader in airline leisure sales and management software) seeks a Technical Consultant to serve as the first point of contact for customer support and technical services, ensuring their software solutions run smoothly.
